brief:
President Mahmoud Abbas and other senior Palestinian Authority officials have mounted significant pressure on leaders of Arab political parties, urging them to form a joint electoral list specifically aimed at toppling Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, according to Hebrew Channel 12. The reported campaign targeted heads of Arab parties with explicit demands to unite around a single unified slate.

The Palestinian Authority's move reflects efforts to coordinate Arab political representation in ways that could influence Israeli electoral outcomes. Channel 12 did not specify which Arab parties were approached or provide details on how party leaders responded to the pressure campaign.

title: Palestinian Authority pressures Arab party leaders to form unified list against Netanyahu
